name: Lifebinding Spirit
text:
Summon a spirit companion (max 1) that follows you and is immune to harm. It can act upon a target within Reach 4 of you before returning to your side. It can:
• Harm. 1 Action: It attacks for 1d8+STR radiant damage (ignoring Armor).
• Mend. 1 Action: (WIL/Safe Rest) It restores WIL d20 HP to a Dying creature.

source.note: Header “SHEPHERD ONLY, CANTRIP”. Harm/Mend rolls are encoded as grant actions on feature.shepherd.my-buddy, not here. The “Flavor is Free” and “Rushed Attacks and My Companion?” sidebar boxes are left out of text. Reach 4 is from the summon sentence (no separate Reach: line).
